question: Find the volume of the largest sphere that can be carved out of a cube of side 21 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Side of cube = 21 cm 

**Formulas used:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3πr³

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4dc33126979b2d5cb19c98c568359035da7343f431d353a72022b9f06c581bc.png] 

The largest sphere that can be carved out of a cube of side 21 cm will have the diameter equal to 21 cm. 

Radius of sphere = 21/2 cm 

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × 22/7 × 21/2 × 21/2 × 21/2 

⇒ 11 × 21 × 21 

⇒ 4851 cm³

**∴ The required result is 4851 cm3**.
